study_design: Prospective nested case-control study using baseline serum samples and follow-up for incident cancers.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Serum 25(OH)D levels of 606 persons (179 cases and 427 controls) from the Balçova Heart Study were measured.
reason: The abstract evaluates incident prostate cancer generally but provides no stage, grade, advanced, metastatic, lethal, or other aggressive prostate cancer analysis. The 179 cases combine lung, breast, colorectal, and prostate cancers, so the prostate cancer case count cannot be extracted.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Serum 25(OH)D levels did not show a significant association with breast, colorectal and prostate cancers.
estimate_classifications.reason: The row concerns serum vitamin D and general incident prostate cancer; no aggressive prostate cancer endpoint is established.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
